# semaphore_ex_global_credential (Data Source)

Reads value-free global Semaphore EX credential metadata.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_global_credential" "deployment_token" {
  id = semaphore_ex_global_credential.deployment_token.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
